$description: Classes going away (VERSIONING.md, Deprecation; issue 882): no page, application in this repository, the design spec, the St. John site, a test or a tool uses them. They keep working until they are removed, no earlier than the next minor release. Check-style fails on a new use (rule deprecated-classes). The tokens going away carry $deprecated in their token file instead. The release that removed 321 of these (issue 125) kept ten that CTM still uses (plx-u-absolute, -bg-transparent, -justify-center, -left-0, -right-0, -text-center, -top-0, -w-100px, -w-36px, -w-72px); they are removed when CTM has moved off them.
